text: Supply chain module is blocking us. Custom SAP code isn't translating via DMS. Going to need manual work.
I can take it. Give me 3 days.
Good. Vikram owns supply chain now. Let's also add a checklist for custom SAP modules in the template — we keep hitting this.
Agreed. Also the finance data has 2-year gaps. Data quality is worse than we thought. Going to need 3 more days for validation.
Was data quality flagged in the proposal? I want to make sure we covered it.
Yes — high risk in proposal. We have contingency budget.
Good. I'll tell the client about the gaps on Thursday's call.
Staging validation for the HR module finished. 0 mismatches across 41 tables.
Nice. Neha, can you run the same check on finance once the gaps are filled?
Will do. Should we use parallel validation like we did for Manufacturing Co?
Yes. Run old and new side by side and compare row counts and checksums per table.
Decision: we use parallel validation for all modules. I'll write it into the design doc today.
Supply chain custom code: 2 of 5 modules done. On track for 3 days.
Client confirmed they will send the missing 2021 finance data by Monday.
Great. If it arrives Monday we keep the cutover date of 2024-06-07.
